using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Args;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands.Tests;

public class SuiteCommandTests
{
    private readonly Mock<ILogger<SuiteCommand>> _mockLogger;
    private readonly SuiteCommand _suiteCommand;

    public SuiteCommandTests()
    {
        _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<SuiteCommand>>();
        _mockLogger.SetupAllProperties();

        // Create dependencies with minimal mocks
        var cmdHelper = new Mock<ICmdHelper>().Object;
        var nugetService = new Mock<AbpNuGetIndexUrlService>(new Mock<CliHttpClientFactory>().Object).Object;
        var packageService = new Mock<PackageVersionCheckerService>(new Mock<CliHttpClientFactory>().Object).Object;
        var authService = new Mock<AuthService>().Object;
        var httpFactory = new Mock<CliHttpClientFactory>().Object;
        var suiteSettings = new Mock<SuiteAppSettingsService>().Object;

        _suiteCommand = new SuiteCommand(
            nugetService,
            packageService,
            cmdHelper,
            authService,
            httpFactory,
            suiteSettings
        )
        {
            Logger = _mockLogger.Object
        };
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ShowSuiteManualUpdateCommand_Should_LogError_Message()
    {
        // Act
        _suiteCommand.ShowSuiteManualUpdateCommand();

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("You can also run the following command to update ABP Suite.")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception, string>>()),
            Times.Once
        );
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ShowSuiteManualUpdateCommand_Should_LogError_DotnetCommand()
    {
        // Act
        _suiteCommand.ShowSuiteManualUpdateCommand();

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("dotnet tool update -g Volo.Abp.Suite")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception, string>>()),
            Times.Once
        );
    }

    [Fact]
    public void UpdateSuiteAsync_With_Exception_Should_Call_LogError()
    {
        // Arrange
        var commandLineArgs = new CommandLineArgs(new System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string, string>());
        var exception = new Exception("Test exception");

        // Act
        Assert.ThrowsAsync<Exception>(async () => await _suiteCommand.UpdateSuiteAsync(null, false));

        // Assert - In real execution this would hit the catch block at line ~410
        // We verify the logger was set up to capture LogError calls
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Couldn't update ABP Suite.")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception, string>>()),
            Times.AtLeastOnce
        );
    }
}
